anomalies.expected: The design specification requires C1 to be 1 uF/25 V, matching C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 in the same EPD driver group.
anomalies.impact: C1 is 10x lower capacitance and has a lower voltage rating than specified on the EPD display power rail, which can degrade charge-pump/boost stability and voltage margin.

parsed.summary: The EPD driver's C1 is specified as 1 uF/25 V but is drawn as 0.1 uF/16 V, the only supported deviation found.
